name: Chef austère
description: A very long-limbed slender adult male chief with olive-grey skin, a narrow long cranial dome, sparse long rope-like dreads and short tusks. Simple flowing charcoal cloak over a dark bronze wrap tunic, a single large round polished bone chest plate and patterned cuff bands. Both hands folded across the chest, no weapons or staff. Elegant austere form, still a distinct Yautja ceremonial leader.
